# Import checklist

**1 folders · 21 markups · 1 imports**

Before you start:
- onX **Premium or Elite** is required to import.
- Use the **Web Map** at webmap.onxmaps.com on a computer.
- Each numbered step is ONE import. Drag in **all** the files for that step together.

### 1. 2027 Dark Divide 100 Mile Endurance Run  (21 markups)

- [ ] My Content → **Import** → select **2027_Dark_Divide_100_Mile_Endurance_Run_Waypoints.gpx, 2027_Dark_Divide_100_Mile_Endurance_Run_Tracks.gpx**
- [ ] Tick **“Import map data to a new folder”**
- [ ] Click **Import**
- [ ] The new folder appears at the top named `Import <today>`. **Rename it to:** `2027 Dark Divide 100 Mile Endurance Run`

### Renamed for onX

These names had `! @ # $ % ^ * &` removed. Search onX for the new name.

- `[r1i1] 02 - Juniper Ridge AS #1 to Sunrise Peak AS` → `[r1i1] 02 - Juniper Ridge AS 1 to Sunrise Peak AS`  (2027 Dark Divide 100 Mile Endurance Run)
- `[r1i1] 03 - Sunrise Peak AS #1 to Dark Creek AS` → `[r1i1] 03 - Sunrise Peak AS 1 to Dark Creek AS`  (2027 Dark Divide 100 Mile Endurance Run)
- `[r1i1] 09 - Summit Prairie AS to Sunrise Peak #2 AS` → `[r1i1] 09 - Summit Prairie AS to Sunrise Peak 2 AS`  (2027 Dark Divide 100 Mile Endurance Run)
- `[r1i1] 10 - Sunrise Peak #2 AS to Juniper Ridge #2 AS` → `[r1i1] 10 - Sunrise Peak 2 AS to Juniper Ridge 2 AS`  (2027 Dark Divide 100 Mile Endurance Run)
- `[r1i1] 11 - Juniper Ridge #2 AS to Cispus Learning Center (FINISH)` → `[r1i1] 11 - Juniper Ridge 2 AS to Cispus Learning Center (FINISH)`  (2027 Dark Divide 100 Mile Endurance Run)

### Notes longer than onX keeps on import (512 characters)

onX cut a longer imported note to 512 characters, and dropped a much longer one entirely. Shorten these, or paste the rest into onX after import.

- `[r1i1] 02 - Juniper Ridge AS (Used Twice)`: 617 characters  (2027 Dark Divide 100 Mile Endurance Run)

---

When finished, My Content should show **1 folders** and **21 markups**.

If a folder is missing items, delete that folder and redo just its step.
